label: Harim

A.name: Harim
A.line: his sons (descendants) returned to Judah after captivity (EZR 2:39)
A.notes: Aaronic priest, named on the sealed document of NEH 10:1-27 (NEH 10:5), Aaronic priest (NEH 10:8)
family: descendant-of aaron (Aaron, brother of Moses (EXO 4:14) and Levitical priest (EXO 28:1))

B.name: Harim
B.line: A priest who seals Nehemiah's covenant

why: חָרִם occurs once in the list, fitting B’s stated role as a priest who seals Nehemiah’s covenant. The surrounding verses provide no genealogy connecting him to A, whose descendants returned from captivity, although A’s notes also claim this passage, leaving the distinction uncertain.
